items.title: Merzouga Golden Escape
items.subtitle: A two-night immersion into the dunes of Erg Chebbi
highlights: Sunrise camel trek to the highest dune
Overnight in a luxury Berber tented camp
Traditional mint tea ceremony at sunset
items.overview: A gentle introduction to the Sahara. Leave the paved road behind in Merzouga and ride a camel caravan into the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. Spend two nights in a luxury Berber camp, wake to sunrise over the dunes, and end each day with mint tea around the fire.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Merzouga
itinerary.description: Meet your guide in Merzouga, leave your vehicle, and begin the camel trek into Erg Chebbi. Arrive at camp for sunset, mint tea, and a traditional Berber dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Dunes & Desert Life
itinerary.description: Sunrise camel ride to the highest dune for panoramic views. Return for breakfast, then a relaxed day exploring nomad families, an underground fossil quarry, and the rhythms of desert life.

itinerary.title: Sunrise & Departure
itinerary.description: A final sunrise from the dunes, breakfast at camp, and a camel ride back to Merzouga. Depart with a memory card full of gold.

items.title: Sahara Grand Crossing
items.subtitle: Five days deep into the dunes, from oasis to oasis
highlights: Multi-day camel caravan across the dunes
Visit to a Gnawa music village
items.overview: For travelers who want to truly disappear into the desert. A five-day camel-supported crossing from Merzouga through the silent dunes of Erg Znigui, sleeping in two different wild camps and meeting the people who call this landscape home.

itinerary.title: Into Erg Chebbi
itinerary.description: Begin in Merzouga. Load the camels and trek into the dunes. First night at a fixed luxury camp with full dinner and stargazing.

itinerary.title: Khamlia & Gnawa Rhythms
itinerary.description: Visit the village of Khamlia, home to a Gnawa music community. After lunch, trek to a wild camp among the smaller dunes of Erg Znigui.

itinerary.title: The Silent Dunes
itinerary.description: A long, slow trek across rolling dunes with no other humans in sight. Lunch in the shade of a tamarisk. Camp near a dry riverbed.

itinerary.title: Nomad Encampment
itinerary.description: Meet a nomad family, share tea, and learn how they move with the seasons. Afternoon climb to a 150m dune for sunset.

itinerary.title: Return to Merzouga
itinerary.description: Final sunrise, breakfast, and a 4x4 transfer back to Merzouga.

items.title: Atlas to Sahara
items.subtitle: From the High Atlas passes to the dunes of Erg Chebbi
highlights: Sunset at Aït Ben Haddou kasbah
Overnight in the dunes of Erg Chebbi
items.overview: A four-day private journey linking two of Morocco's great landscapes: the mud-brick kasbahs of the High Atlas and the golden dunes of the Sahara. Travel by 4x4 with a local driver-guide, ending with a night in a luxury desert camp.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Aït Ben Haddou
itinerary.description: Cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass through the High Atlas. Arrive at Aït Ben Haddou for a guided sunset tour of the UNESCO-listed kasbah. Overnight in a kasbah guesthouse.

itinerary.title: The Road to the Dades
itinerary.description: Drive through the Valley of a Thousand Kasbahs and the Dades Gorge. Lunch in a local family home. Afternoon drive to Merzouga.

itinerary.title: Into the Sahara
itinerary.description: Swap the 4x4 for camels and trek into Erg Chebbi. Sunset, mint tea, and a night in a luxury Berber camp with stargazing.

itinerary.title: Sunrise & Return
itinerary.description: Sunrise over the dunes, breakfast, and the camel ride back to Merzouga. 4x4 transfer back to Marrakech.

items.title: Stargazing Night Camp
items.subtitle: One night, one camp, the whole sky
items.overview: A single unforgettable night in the desert. Arrive in Merzouga in the afternoon, camel-trek to a luxury camp, and spend the evening with a local astronomer, Berber drummers, and the clearest sky you'll ever see.

itinerary.title: Sunset & Stars
itinerary.description: Afternoon camel trek into the dunes. Arrive at camp for sunset, mint tea, and dinner. After dinner, a guided telescope session and Berber drumming around the fire.

itinerary.title: Sunrise & Departure
itinerary.description: Early hike to a nearby dune for sunrise. Breakfast at camp, then camel ride back to Merzouga.

items.title: Nomad & Berber Immersion
items.subtitle: Live with the people of the desert for four days
highlights: Learn to bake bread in the sand
items.overview: A cultural deep-dive. Spend four days with the people of the Sahara — nomad families, Berber weavers, and the guides who grew up between these dunes. You'll eat, sleep, and travel as they do.

itinerary.title: Meet the Nomads
itinerary.description: Camel trek from Merzouga to a nomad family's seasonal encampment. Share tea, learn how they move with the seasons, and sleep in a traditional tent.

itinerary.title: Bread in the Sand
itinerary.description: Spend the day with the family. Learn to bake sand-baked bread, milk the goats, and prepare a tagine. Afternoon walk to a nearby fossil bed.

itinerary.title: Weaving Workshop
itinerary.description: Travel to a Berber weaving cooperative. Spend the day learning the patterns and stories woven into each carpet. Overnight in a wild camp.

itinerary.title: Return to Merzouga
itinerary.description: Sunrise, breakfast, and camel ride back to Merzouga.

items.title: Private Bespoke Desert
items.subtitle: Your own route, your own pace, your own Sahara
items.overview: For travelers who want something truly their own. Tell us what you dream of — a helicopter drop into a remote dune field, a private camp for two, a photography expedition — and we'll build it.

itinerary.title: Consultation
itinerary.description: A call with our team to understand your group, your dates, and what kind of desert experience you're after.

itinerary.title: Tailored Proposal
itinerary.description: We send a bespoke itinerary with route, camp, and guide options within 48 hours.

itinerary.title: Your Journey
itinerary.description: Everything is arranged. You arrive and the desert does the rest.
